faq.title: 508PS V8 Questions
faq.description: Useful answers on pricing, warranty, specification and fitting for the Jaguar XF Sportbrake 508PS engine.

faqs.q: How much is a Jaguar XF Sportbrake 508PS engine replacement?
faqs.a: The cost depends on whether you choose a used, reconditioned or rebuilt V8 and whether we fit it. Send your registration for a written quote itemising parts and labour.

faqs.q: Do your 508PS engines include warranty cover?
faqs.a: Yes. Engines we supply come with a six-month mechanical warranty. We'll explain exactly what's covered and any conditions, including those for third-party fitting, before you order.

faqs.q: Was a 508PS V8 Sportbrake available in 2012?
faqs.a: No. The supercharged V8 estate arrived as the XFR-S Sportbrake, revealed in 2014. Earlier Sportbrakes used four-cylinder or V6 engines, so we confirm your engine code using the VIN.

faqs.q: What power does the XFR-S Sportbrake's 508PS produce?
faqs.a: It is rated at 550PS, or 542bhp, with 680Nm of torque. Listings quoting around 471hp are likely to refer to the lower-output XF saloon tune, so check specifications carefully before buying.

faqs.q: What are common Jaguar XF Sportbrake 508PS engine problems?
faqs.a: Reported issues on this V8 include timing chain tensioner wear, water pump and coolant leaks, and supercharger coupling noise. Symptoms can overlap, so diagnosis should come before any repair decision.

faqs.q: Can you deliver a 508PS to my own specialist?
faqs.a: Yes. Supply-only engines are delivered by pallet across the UK to homes or independent garages. We confirm compatibility before dispatch and explain warranty conditions for outside fitting.

faqs.q: What does your V8 supply and fit service cover?
faqs.a: At our Grays, Essex workshop we remove the failed engine, fit the replacement, refill fluids, complete software setup and road test your Sportbrake. Timescales are agreed when we quote.

workshopIntro.title: Deciding How to Fix Your 508PS V8
workshopIntro.description: A thorough diagnosis should always come first. Water pump leaks, coil faults and supercharger coupling noise can often be repaired without touching the engine's internals. If chain failure or overheating has caused serious damage, compare the repair estimate with your car's condition and value.
paragraphs: The Jaguar XF Sportbrake 508PS engine replacement cost depends on the engine type, its history and whether installation is included. A supercharged V8 swap involves substantial labour, so full supply and fit quotes are the fairest way to compare suppliers.

When browsing 508PS 5.0 V8 supercharged petrol engine UK listings, check which vehicle and output each engine came from. Ask about mileage, service history and pre-sale checks so you can judge their true value confidently.

Warranty cover is equally important. A Jaguar XF Sportbrake 508PS engine with warranty offers protection if a mechanical fault develops after fitting. Engines we supply include a six-month mechanical warranty, and we explain the terms before you go ahead.

engineProblems.title: Jaguar XF Sportbrake 508PS Engine Problems Owners Report
engineProblems.description: Any of these could suggest a fault; diagnosis is needed for certainty.

cards.title: Cold Start Chain Rattle
cards.description: A rattle lasting a few seconds after a cold start may relate to worn timing chain tensioners or guides.
cards.action: Have the timing system inspected soon.

cards.title: Coolant Loss or Overheating
cards.description: Falling coolant, a sweet smell or rising temperature could point to a water pump, thermostat housing or pipe leak.
cards.action: Stop and request a pressure test.

cards.title: Supercharger Noise at Idle
cards.description: A rattling or chattering sound at idle may come from the supercharger drive coupling, which is a reported wear point.

cards.title: Misfires or Rough Running
cards.description: Hesitation, a flashing engine light or uneven idle could stem from ignition coils, spark plugs or fuel injectors.
cards.action: Avoid hard acceleration until it's checked.

cards.title: Visible Oil Leaks
cards.description: Oil spots under the car or a burning smell may indicate leaking cam cover, timing cover or sump seals.

cards.title: Timing Fault Codes
cards.description: Engine warning lights with camshaft correlation codes might suggest chain stretch or variable cam timing problems needing investigation.
cards.action: Arrange a full diagnostic scan promptly.

engineOverview.title: The Supercharged 5.0 V8 Behind the XFR-S Sportbrake
paragraphs: The 508PS is Jaguar's 5.0-litre supercharged V8 from the AJ133 family, with direct fuel injection and an eight-speed automatic gearbox featuring Jaguar's Quickshift technology. In the XFR-S Sportbrake it produces 550PS, equal to 542bhp or 405kW, with 680Nm of torque sent to the rear wheels.

Searches for a Jaguar XF Sportbrake 508PS engine 2012 can mislead, as the V8 estate was revealed in 2014; before then, Sportbrakes used four-cylinder or V6 engines. Likewise, the Jaguar XF Sportbrake 5.0 V8 supercharged petrol engine 471hp figure sits closer to the XF saloon's 470PS tune than the XFR-S.

Because the same engine family appears in several Jaguar and Land Rover models with different outputs and ancillaries, VIN matching matters. Regular oil changes and a healthy cooling system help protect the chains and supercharger, while major internal damage may make replacement the practical choice.
